title: Service media lifecycle final closure candidate
rootCause: The services repository still contained a complete legacy direct media upload and review submission implementation.
The legacy implementation could select predictable Storage paths, request upsert and mutate the service_media projection outside the signed upload intent authority.
Although database grants, Storage policies and the dispatcher already failed closed, the business service still exposed a repository submission branch for fixture mode.
changes: services-service routes all Supabase and UUID submissions exclusively through the signed upload authority.
Non-UUID fixtures are saved only through repository.save with fixture-memory state.
The structural audit rejects reintroduction of the legacy repository submission route.
The runtime covers both signed Supabase submission and fixture-memory submission and requires zero legacy repository submissions.
remainingRisks: The dead legacy helper source still exists inside services-repository.js, but it is no longer reachable from the business service and all remote authorities fail closed.
The complete GitHub CI lanes must converge on one stable final head before CAT-A04 is declared closed.
The domain matrix and engineering journal remain for final reconciliation after CI evidence is available.
No destructive test was executed with a real or persistent synthetic entity.
nextControlledStep: Confirm Quality, blocking E2E, 105 visual structural guards, Canary and Diagnostic on one stable head; then reconcile journal and matrix without changing production.
